mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS RESERVATION_COUNT FROM COUNSEL_RESERVATION CR JOIN STUDENT_DETAIL SD ON CR.STUDENT_NO = SD.STUDENT_NO WHERE SD.USER_NO = #{userNo}

SELECT CR.RESERVATION_NO, CR.STUDENT_NO, CR.CATEGORY_NO, CR.CONSULT_DATE, CR.INQUIRY_CONTENT, CR.RESERVATION_STATUS, CR.CREATED_AT, CR.UPDATED_AT, CR.COUNSEL_NO, M.USER_NAME AS COUNSELOR_NAME, CC.CATEGORY_NAME FROM COUNSEL_RESERVATION CR JOIN STUDENT_DETAIL SD ON CR.STUDENT_NO = SD.STUDENT_NO JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE CP ON CR.COUNSEL_NO = CP.COUNSEL_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON CP.USER_NO = M.USER_NO JOIN COUNSEL_CATEGORY CC ON CR.CATEGORY_NO = CC.CATEGORY_NO WHERE SD.USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY CR.RESERVATION_NO DESC
SELECT * FROM COUNSEL_CATEGORY ORDER BY CATEGORY_NO ASC
